title: Adonai Mitchell’s long-awaited Jets return from mystery finger injury gives offense the boost it needs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Adonai Mitchell’s long-awaited Jets return from mystery finger injury gives offense the boost it needs
sources.description: Adonai Mitchell may have been dealing with more than a finger injury. It appears he also has a case of amnesia — at least when it comes to the finger on his right hand that has kept him out of action for four games.
